scope: Archive live target/hybrid checks with source and NPU artifact verification.

registration.scope:
Bounded live E2B GPU target plus BF16 Phoenix NPU speculative drafting.

Greedy correctness experiment, not a serving or speed qualification. Fresh target
hidden/KV and GPU embeddings supply every draft. No captured inference tensors.

contract.scope:
Compile packet commands whose BF16 intermediate values stay on the NPU.

Host code packs weights and metadata only. A static initialization map rejects
reads of unwritten arena locations before compilation or device execution.
This is a research command stream, outside the ONNX graph compiler.
